# 反事实：基础随机实验与DiD示例
import numpy as np
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
n=400;D=rng.binomial(1,.5,n)
X=rng.normal(size=n);Y=1.5*D+X+rng.normal(size=n)
effect=Y[D==1].mean()-Y[D==0].mean()
print("Randomized ATE estimate:",effect)
pre_t,post_t=100.,116.;pre_c,post_c=90.,98.
print("DiD:",(post_t-pre_t)-(post_c-pre_c))

# 交易成本变化：基础随机实验与DiD示例
import numpy as np
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
n=400;D=rng.binomial(1,.5,n)
X=rng.normal(size=n);Y=1.5*D+X+rng.normal(size=n)
effect=Y[D==1].mean()-Y[D==0].mean()
print("Randomized ATE estimate:",effect)

print("DiD:",(post_t-pre_t)-(post_c-pre_c))
